about: Teeth (H1 combat teeth, docs/team/hook/H1_combat_teeth.md): what a table night's tier asks of a human, on top of the night's own curves; numbers described in logic/Content/Teeth.cs. Measured with the harness's late hands: `arena --bot plain,deft,human,careless`, then tools/balance/danger.py. A tier with no entry is as it was. Tier 1, round 1 (H1, 3 Nov; 128 nights a bot at 12 min, kit on): fodder fall to 3 of her hits and champions to 9 (ember 0-10); the late human ends at 31% of life at its lowest and falls 15%, careless 20%, the deft hands win 96%; the boss comes at 10:00 and takes about 2:15. Round 2 (3 Nov): with the kit's bite raised, the tier-1 boss hits x1.1 (from 1.25): careless fall 22%, human 15% (lowest life median 0.29), deft win 98%; fodder 3 hits, champions 9.5-10, boss about 2:13. The director (H6 item 3, 4 Nov; logic/Play/Zones/ArenaRun.Director.cs, fields in Teeth.Director): pincers from behind, a leader cutting her off, a surround closing as the kit's wall, a stander charged, stuck foes recalled, the snuffer explained once; tier 1 only for now. H6 round 1 (4 Nov): heals were about six lives a night from drops and the crowd ran at her pace; both cut (fodderHeals/eliteHeals 0.35, fodderSpeed 0.7) so moving pays, plus the Ironback (a slow champion that slams a stander) and the pack feeding at its dead. H6 tuning (4 Nov; 128 nights a bot): a stander's charger is now picked at least standFrom 7 m off (one at her elbow died in its windup, so no stand charge landed) and the stand is read as under 0.6 m in 1.5 s (a melee orbit is not standing), charging at 2.2; the lamp draws a flank each 30 s; boss x2.0 health, x0.55 blows; fodder pace 0.65; the Reaver's armor 3 to 4 (archetypes.json): standing falls 100%, the idler 75% (88 of 96 before the boss), human wins 82% (lowest life 0.29, callings 78-91), deft 96%, careless 73%.

fordWarden.about: The Ford-Warden (H8, N20; numbers by H6, 4 Nov; measured by H8 on the first-time path). floors: by lamps still unbroken this fight, 0-3 (3 minus those his charge or her blows broke; a relight never takes one back): the least share of his life he can be brought to, 0.67 with none broken, 0.34 with one, none with two (two crashes are the way through; b_path on lamps lit had his channels relight them six times in 338 s). ward: by lamps lit, the share of a blow he takes. hpMul on his 2600. minSeconds: a backstop, the last floor held at backstop until he has fought this long. crackAfter: seconds held at one floor before it cracks a step (no player held for good). Targets: a human 60-90 s, every calling's careless bot wins, no fall for the deft.

corvane.about: Corvane in the doorway (vault_opened's first stage, Play/Story/Corvane.cs, Play/Bosses/CorvaneStory.cs; P6, 5 Nov). A lesson the Ford-Warden's length (prologue.fordWarden: a human 60-90 s, his minSeconds 60 backstop) under H1's boss rules (one signature behind its 0.7 s tell, the kit's marks read at 85% by H6's human). hpMul: his life over his def's at his level (as a story boss's HealthMul, eased by tier). teeth: his blow as a share of her calling's own health (StoryBoss.Teeth). cuffMul/cuffEvery: the lamp swing at what stands across his path, a share of his blow and its seconds. tether: metres he may stand from his mark, holding the door. talkAfter: seconds after the arrival before door_night opens. holdAfterRaise: seconds he does nothing after she raises her weapon (hers strike first). firstAfter: seconds from the raise to the first signature. every/everyLow: seconds between signatures, and below lowAt of his life. reach/reachLow: the kit pull's reach in metres (it drags her toward him), and below lowAt. slam: the pull's heart in metres (its blow and its slam, which knocks her down). pullDamage: the pull's damage over the kit's. floor: his one phase's floor in seconds (the Flare cuts it). minSeconds/backstop: held at backstop of his life until he has fought this long. lampEnergy/lampEnergyLow: his lamp's light (Enemies.cs corvane's CarriedLight, held out at the lamp), brighter below lowAt (the only sign); glow/glowLow: his body's glow, kept low (0.3 burned the robe white, r4). tellLight/tellLift: his lamp's light through the tell, times its own, and how far it is lifted (m) as the cast raises the lamp overhead; back down after the slam (judge r1 fix 4). haloLow/poolLow/coreLow: below lowAt, the lamp's glow across and its ground pool's reach times their own, and its core's whiteness (0 its color, 1 white; its own 0.3, Enemies.cs) (judge r2 fix 6). emberFloor: the ember she has at least when the court ends (0: no EMBER banners or arsenal toasts bury the door's line; SouthEnd's own floor 10 covers her build). Measured with `story --fight vault --stage court --bot standing,human,deft`; targets: standing falls on most nights, human wins with no kill under 60 s (median 70-100), deft wins 95%+.
